backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing user profiles, access control roles, trending media lists, and tracked shows with storage mixin integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to related files, components, tests, and descriptions.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of key frontend files and components.
frontend/.env.example: Environment variable template providing an optional TMDB API key placeholder.
frontend/.gitignore: Gitignore settings excluding logs, dependencies, build outputs, editor files, and environment files.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point loading the React application root and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component coordinating layout, media selection modal logic, identity state, profile setup gating, and section rendering.
frontend/src/components/AddShowDialog.ts: Dialog component allowing authenticated users to search for TV shows and add them to their tracked list with error handling.
Banner component that displays TMDB API health warnings and fallback key notices when the API is unhealthy.
frontend/src/components/ContentGrid.tsx: Displays trending content with loading skeletons, error states, empty state, and a grid of MediaCard items.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedRow.tsx: Renders a horizontal featured content row with loading and error states, filtering out items already shown in Trending.
frontend/src/components/FilterBar.tsx: Provides dropdown filters for media type and sorting, showing a badge when filtered to a specific type.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Shows site footer with credits and external links to caffeine.ai and TMDB.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Top navigation bar handling login/logout via Internet Identity and displaying the user's name when authenticated.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Large hero section with a background image and title text promoting trending content.
frontend/src/components/MediaCard.tsx: Displays a media item with poster, metadata, trailer CTA, and TV show tracking actions for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/NetflixTop10.tsx: Shows a Netflix-branded top 10 section selecting unique trending items with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal for entering and saving a user's name via mutation with basic validation and success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/TrackedShows.tsx: Loads and displays tracked shows with loading, error, and empty states, and supports removing shows and updating last visit.
frontend/src/components/TrailerModal.tsx: Modal that fetches and displays a trailer for a media item with lifecycle logging, error handling, and retry support.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, stored identity loading, and status management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for TMDB data, trailers, tracked shows, user profiles, and includes API health checks and fetch utilities.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind layers plus extensive CSS variables and animated gradient backgrounds define light/dark themes and custom scrollbars.
frontend/src/lib/devDiagnostics.ts: Provides development‑only console logging helpers for trailer, media selection, fetch, result, and iframe lifecycle events.
frontend/src/lib/mediaKeys.ts: Utility functions for generating stable media keys, selecting unique items, and filtering items by exclusion sets.
frontend/src/lib/sectionTheme.ts: Exports shared class name constants for consistent section headers, spacing, grids, and glassmorphic UI elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts: Extends Vite's type definitions to include the optional TMDB API key environment variable.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration customizing theme colors from CSS variables, animations, container settings, and plugins.
project_state.json: Captures project metadata, architecture notes, and known issues for the React+Motoko CineStream application.
